Warshim Chesam (born July 18, 2000, in Mayang Imphal Chirai, Imphal West, Manipur, India) is a prominent Indian bodybuilder and fitness trainer. He has garnered significant acclaim for his achievements in bodybuilding, including winning [https://www.ifp.co.in/sports/bodybuilders-leave-for-asian-championship-2023-at-kathmandu Mr. Asia], [https://ibbf.in/pdf/Result/14thMrIndia-result.pdf Mr. India], and multiple [https://e-pao.net/GP.asp?src=Sport1..051222.dec22 Mr. Manipur titles]. Known for his dedication to fitness and his influential role as a trainer, Chesam has inspired many individuals to pursue bodybuilding. He currently resides in Minuthong Hafiz Hatta, Imphal East, Manipur. He is 24 years old and has a height of 5'10.His influence extends beyond the gym, as he continues to inspire others through his dedication to the sport.
Early life and education
From a young age, Chesam showed a keen interest in physical fitness and sports. He pursued his higher education at [https://mbcollege.edu.in/ Maharaja Bodhchandra College] in Imphal, where he balanced his academic pursuits with his passion for bodybuilding. This commitment to both education and fitness laid a strong foundation for his future career.
Career
Warshim Chesam's career in bodybuilding is marked by a series of impressive achievements, reflecting his dedication and hard work:
* Mr. Asia 2023: Chesam won the [http://www.wbpsf.org/PDF/Result/55th%20ABBF%20CHAMPIONSHIP%202023-NEPAL-REPORT.pdf Mr. Asia title at the Asian Bodybuilding and Physique Sports Championship] held in Kathmandu, Nepal. This prestigious event, organized by the Asian Bodybuilding and Physique Sports Federation (ABBF), showcased the best talent from across the continent .
* Mr. India 2022: In 2022, Chesam claimed the [https://ibbf.in/pdf/Result/14thMrIndia-result.pdf Mr. India] title at the Indian Bodybuilding and Fitness Federation (IBBF) competition. This victory solidified his status as one of India's top bodybuilders .
* Mr. Manipur: Chesam has dominated the state-level competition by winning the overall Mr. Manipur title three consecutive times in 2021, 2022, and 2023. This consistent performance highlights his exceptional prowess and dedication to the sport https://www.thesangaiexpress.com/Encyc/2023/12/12/By-Our-Staff-ReporterIMPHAL-Dec-11-Maibam-Robert-of-YVO-Gym-Wabagai-clinched-the-Mr-Manipur-title-in-the.html
* Mr. I/E & Mr. Khamba 2022: He also secured the overall titles in these regional competitions, further demonstrating his versatility and excellence in bodybuilding.
Chesam's remarkable physique and performance have earned him numerous accolades and a bronze medal in the men's sports physique category at the [https://easternmirrornagaland.com/manipurs-chesam-clinches-bronze-in-body-building-championship/ 55th Asian Bodybuilding and Physique Sports Championship in 2023] .Warshim Chesan's career in bodybuilding is distinguished by numerous titles and accolades. Warshim Chesam's success has paved the way for future generations of bodybuilders in Manipur and India. His disciplined approach and commitment to the sport have made him a standout competitor in various bodybuilding championships.
Personal life
Warshim Chesam is not just a competitive bodybuilder; he is also a dedicated fitness trainer who has positively influenced many lives. He has helped numerous individuals achieve their fitness goals, transforming their physiques and fostering a healthier lifestyle. His role as a trainer extends beyond physical training; he inspires and motivates his clients to reach their full potential.

Additional information
Warshim Chesam is a transformative figure in the bodybuilding community. His journey from a young fitness enthusiast in Manipur to a celebrated bodybuilder and trainer serves as an inspiration to many. Through his training and mentorship, he has changed numerous lives, helping people achieve their bodybuilding dreams and promoting a culture of health and fitness.
